verdict.line: You lose if you let him land E (Mourning Mist) near a W (Dark Procession) wall and get chain-chewed by Mist Walkers before level 6; you win if you survive the poke phase and force all-ins once your Q (Tongue Lash) stacks reach 3.

brief.thesis: This is a 41.7% matchup over 115 games because Yorick's Q (Last Rites) empowered auto and E (Mourning Mist) poke chip you down for free while his Mist Walkers punish you for standing near a W (Dark Procession) wall. Tahm has no ranged poke to answer this — his entire kit is built around closing the gap with W (Abyssal Dive) and finishing with Q's stun, so every early trade happens on Yorick's terms. The matchup is genuinely even in solo-kill potential and evens out structurally once Tahm's health stacking comes online, but that only matters if you survive levels 1-6 first.

tell.watch: Your Q stack count on him

theirWindow.when: he lands E (Mourning Mist) on you near his wall
theirWindow.what: Mourning Mist marks and slows you while summoned Mist Walkers gain move speed toward marked targets and swarm you — if his W (Dark Procession) wall is also up nearby, back off immediately rather than fighting through it, since you can't disengage once walled in.

yourWindow.when: you land a 3rd Q (Tongue Lash) stack
yourWindow.what: At 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, Tongue Lash stuns him and consumes the stacks instead of just slowing — follow immediately with W (Abyssal Dive) to knock him up again and commit; OP.GG's own read on this matchup is that you get a kill any time you land a clean hit on him.

powerCurve.note: Last Rites empowered autos out-trade your melee poke
W (Abyssal Dive) engage starts matching his poke
Heartsteel bulk outscales his dueling without Maiden

start.why: The passive block and sustain blunt Last Rites' empowered auto and the chip from Mourning Mist, which are the two things actually hurting you levels 1-5.

boots.why: Mist Walkers and Yorick's own autos are the bulk of your incoming damage in lane, and flat armor cuts both down directly.

core.why: Stacked health directly scales An Acquired Taste's bonus auto damage and the size of the shield E (Thick Skin) converts stored damage into.
Continues the health-stacking pattern that both your damage passive and your sustain scale off of.
Punishes an auto-attack-reliant Mist Walker dueling pattern and is the most picked third item in this matchup at 21% pick rate.

situational.when: he's leaning hard on Mist Walker auto-stacking to chip you down in extended trades
fights are turning into grouped skirmishes where his Walkers and Maiden swarm multiple targets
the enemy team adds magic damage sources that make your Thick Skin shield and passive sustain less efficient

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustains you through the early poke trades against Last Rites and Mourning Mist while you stack the health that both your passive damage and Thick Skin's shield scale off.

summoners.why: Teleport lets you play the scaling side of this matchup safely and still get back to a split push once Heartsteel comes online; Exhaust is the direct answer if you'd rather shut down his E-W all-in attempts before they land instead of playing around them.

playing.title: Don't walk up near his wall
playing.detail: If his W (Dark Procession) is up and you're in Mourning Mist range, assume he's setting up the trap — Mourning Mist's mark pulls Mist Walkers onto you faster, and the wall cuts off your retreat.

playing.title: Kill Mist Walkers first
playing.detail: Once you're hit by E (Mourning Mist), the summoned Walkers swarm and attack you directly — clear them before trading autos with Yorick himself.

playing.title: Count your Q stacks on him
playing.detail: Tongue Lash applies a stack of An Acquired Taste on hit; the moment you have 3, your next Q stuns instead of slows, so bait a hit specifically to set this up before committing.

playing.title: Pre-shield before his burst lands
playing.detail: E (Thick Skin)'s passive banks stored damage out of combat, but you need to actually hit the active before his Last Rites-into-Mourning Mist combo connects for the shield to matter.

playing.title: Dive him during his Q windup
playing.detail: Last Rites commits him to an attack animation for its heal — use W (Abyssal Dive) to knock him up and interrupt the trade before he gets the bonus damage and sustain off.

playing.title: Devour the Maiden, not the fight
playing.detail: If he ults, Q-W into position and use R (Devour) on the Maiden of the Mist, then walk it under your turret to remove it before it starts raising Walkers from kills.

playing.title: Don't force fights before Heartsteel stacks
playing.detail: Your damage and shield size both scale off total health, so look to disengage and farm Heartsteel's passive rather than taking even trades early.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the ability interactions, timing windows, and tactical reasoning connecting them are my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Yorick’s (E)-(W). His (P) Mist Walkers will attack you once hit with (E), so get rid of them quickly. You will get a kill if you can hit Yorick. If Yorick uses (R), use [Q]-[W] to swallow it and throw it under your turret to get rid of it quickly.
